newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VAN HOOYDONK'S CELTIC FUTURE STILL IN DOUBT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VAN HOOYDONK'S CELTIC FUTURE STILL IN DOUBT.

text.p: Pierre van Hooydonk's future at Celtic is still uncertain despite his two goals in his side's 2-2 draw at Hearts in the Scottish premier division on Sunday.
The Dutch striker evaded the issue afterwards when he was questioned about his future by a television reporter as he left the field.
But manager Tommy Burns said he is prepared to talk about a new contract as soon as possible.
"As soon as his agent lets us know, there'll be no problem," he said.
Van Hooydonk has been in dispute with the club but, after a meeting with Burns, appeared to have settled it.
He has since scored a last-minute winner against Motherwell and scored twice against Hearts which took his tally for Celtic to 50. He has already scored 10 this season.
But Celtic lost the chance to go top of the premier division when they conceded an injury-time goal to Hearts after leading 2-0.
Burns was unhappy at the lapses of concentration in his defence at both goals.
"The goals we lost were preventable and a bit of concentration would have helped the situation," he complained. "But we had half a dozen players out and there were a lot of pluses for us."
Portugese striker Jorge Cadete, who has been struggling with a hamstring injury, missed the match but Burns is hopeful he will be available to face Hibs on Saturday.
While Van Hooydonk scored twice for Celtic, Colin Cameron and Dave McPherson replied for Hearts.
